instructions.question: Judging the body of the tweet (not just its hashtags), does it express hostility toward immigrants, refugees or migrants as people?
counts_as_yes: dehumanising or demeaning them (invaders, vermin, bottom feeders, rapefugees, scum, POS, parasites), including dehumanising hashtags such as #Rapefugee, #StopTheInvasion, #RefugeesNotWelcome, #DeportRapefugees even with little body text

framing immigrants, refugees or illegal aliens as criminals, rapists, attackers, diseased or a threat, including crime news presented as typical ('another illegal alien...', 'migrant attack in progress')

demanding that they be deported or expelled as a group ('send them back', 'deport them all', 'they don't belong here'), including short approving replies or tweets made up mostly of deportation hashtags
Mexicans, Hispanics, Africans, Muslims etc. when they are framed as migrants
counts_as_no: plain immigration policy talk: build the wall, fund ICE, end DACA, election or #MAGA promotion with border hashtags
tweets whose body attacks Democrats, Congress, liberals, the media or politicians, with immigration hashtags tacked on
tweets not about immigrants at all, and tweets criticising racism against immigrants

instructions.question: Does the tweet put down a woman or women: hostile slurs (bitch, hoe, whore, slut, cunt) aimed at a woman or girl, threats or sexual aggression toward her, or degrading generalisations about women or 'hoes'/'bitches' as a group?

generic degrading statements ('bitches be...', 'these hoes ain't loyal', 'hoes need to die'), including rap-lyric style lines about hoes
stacking several slurs (bitch + hoe, whore, cunt) at someone in a hostile way
rape jokes, sexual threats or violence aimed at women

affection or greetings to friends ('happy birthday bitch, love you')
exclamations and idioms ('bitch I'm on my way', 'life's a bitch', 'karma's a bitch', 'son of a bitch')
slurs aimed at men (e.g. calling a male politician or a guy a bitch)
a single mild 'bitch' at someone whose gender is unclear, with no other slur
a single 'bitch' in a joke, question or banter ('are those not grapes bitch?') with no other slur

instructions.task: Decide whether this tweet is hateful toward immigrants, refugees, migrants or 'illegal aliens'. Look at what the tweet's own text says; border-policy hashtags alone do not decide it.
hateful_if: it calls them names or treats them as less than human: invaders, vermin, scum, POS, bottom feeders, parasites, or hashtags such as #Rapefugee, #StopTheInvasion, #RefugeesNotWelcome
it portrays immigrants or refugees as criminals, rapists, attackers, disease carriers or a danger, e.g. crime stories framed as typical of illegal aliens
it wants them deported, sent back or kept out as a group: 'send them home', 'deport them all', 'they don't belong here', or a short cheering reply made of deportation hashtags
Mexicans, Hispanics, Africans or Muslims are attacked as migrants
not_hateful_if: it only argues for border policy: the wall, ICE, ending DACA, Trump or #MAGA promotion
the real target is Democrats, Congress, liberals, the media or a politician, and immigration hashtags are just appended
it is not about immigrants, or it condemns racism against them
